Problem Description
:  ELMS Query
Troubleshooting
:  As outlined in the ELMS Manual, the charger assesses the current status of both the AC and DC charging outlets, dynamically calculates the minimum achievable power limit (G_Power_Min), and transmits this value back to ELMS. If ELMS sends a limit below this calculated value, it is disregarded. The default value is 1.5 kW when no charging is active, and it increases by 4 kW for each active charging port.
Please refer to the relevant section in the ELMS Manual, which you have already highlighted for further details.

additional_info.subject: RE: AW: 0399198 - ID0399198-DC/Si-D/CH- [MP / N4 160339049] The Sicharge D does not regulate down to 0kW via Modbus-TCP. CRM:02023000417
additional_info.body:
Hello Yannick,
Greetings of the day!
Difference between Fast shutdown and Emergency shutdown is stated below:
Fast Shutdown:
Fastshutdown mode allows for a controlled shutdown.
Charger has the feature -Self-checks & health monitoring. The charging station autonomously checks whether it is in good electrical condition.
During each boot process, it is checked whether the quick shutdown of the converters is working correctly (This is checked to confirm whether the converters can be able to ramp down its voltage quickly in case of emergency).
The charging station not only detects whether the right number of converters is in a group, but also whether the right converter group is going into fast
shutdown.
This feature ensures additional operational reliability, especially with regard to retrofitting of converters.
Emergency Shutdown:
The emergency shutdown mode is used for immediate and uncontrolled shutdown of the charger.
It is triggered in case of critical faults, safety issues, or when the user presses the emergency stop button.
In this mode, the charger will immediately disconnect from the electric vehicle and shut down the power output as quickly as possible.
The emergency shutdown is designed to prioritize safety and halt the charging process immediately to prevent any potential hazards.
For any further information, you can refer to Operating instructions manual of Sicharge D. Link attached below:
sicharge_d_operating_instructions_en-US_en-US.pdf - SICHARGE D charging station - ID: 109796320 - Industry Support Siemens
I hope this answers your query.
Please let us know if you have any further questions or if we should proceed with closing this case.
Thank you
Best Regards
eMobility Tech Support Team - Vaishnavi Raut
